End of the race and podium procedures
At the end of the race all cars will take the chequered flag and do a cool down lap.
At the end of the cool down lap, the overall leader and a selected number of cars will cross the Line a second time to enter the pit lane
by pit exit in the opposite direction. These cars must bear totally left at MP1 and MP2 in order to enter the pits by the pit exit. The
selected car numbers will be posted on the timing monitors.
Excepting the above, at the end of the cool down lap, the overall leaders of each class will enter the pit lane by pit entry and drive their
cars to park under the podium,
Excepting the 2 previous points, all others will drive their cars to the Parc Fermé area on the Le Mans logo.
Co drivers of the cars that are parked under the podium must join their cars immediately.
Drivers and team managers of the top 3 placed cars in each class must go straight to podium after the chequered flag.

Excepting the 2 previous points, all other will drive their cars to the Parc Ferme area on the Le Mans logo.
Winning crew of each of the 3 categories must go straight to underneath the podium before the podium procedure.
Drivers and team managers of the top 3 placed cars in each class must go straight to podium after the chequered flag. The easiest entry
door is via pit lane or at the rear of the module sportif building and proceed upstairs to level 1.
For the podium procedure of the overall winner, skates may be used to ease up the positioning of the car under the podium.
